vBRIEFInfo.description: Story vBRIEF for #1650 (Category B corpus namespacing + allow-list removal); part of the #2034 decomposition.

plan.title: Category B corpus namespacing and conformance allow-list removal

narratives.Description: Migrate the existing vBRIEF corpus so non-core directive keys move under the x-xbrief/ extension namespace, then delete the temporary conformance allow-list once the corpus is clean. This is a corpus-wide scripted migration over hundreds of artifacts, so it is marked sequential and run solo as one operation.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. Add a one-shot codemod script that rewrites Category B keys (such as plan.policy fields) into x-xbrief/ namespaced form across every vbrief artifact, run it, and validate the whole corpus. 2. Remove the ALLOW_LIST from the conformance module packages/core/src/vbrief-validate/conformance.ts and update its tests so the conformance gate enforces namespacing with no exceptions; run the conformance verify suite.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive maintainer, I want the corpus namespaced and the allow-list removed, so that the conformance gate enforces x-xbrief/ extensions with no grandfathered exceptions.

items.title: Given the corpus, when the codemod runs, then every artifact validates with namespaced keys

narrative.Acceptance: Given the full vbrief corpus, when the codemod runs, then every artifact validates and non-core keys are under x-xbrief/.

items.title: Given a clean corpus, when the allow-list is removed, then the conformance gate stays green

narrative.Acceptance: Given the namespaced corpus, when the ALLOW_LIST is deleted, then the conformance gate runs green without exceptions.

items.title: Given a stray non-namespaced key, when the gate runs, then it fails and names the artifact

narrative.Acceptance: Given an artifact with a non-core key outside x-xbrief/, when the conformance gate runs, then it fails and names the artifact.

x-tracking.sequential_reason: corpus-wide migration over hundreds of files; single scripted operation

expected_outputs: corpus namespaced under x-xbrief/; conformance ALLOW_LIST removed; conformance gate green
